product_brief: Thales 5G PQC SIM cards deployed on SKT trial 5G standalone network to protect subscriber identity and privacy.
pqc_capability_description: Successfully tested advanced quantum-resistant cryptography on a 5G standalone network environment. The solution uses the Crystals-Kyber algorithm to encrypt and decrypt subscriber identity, protecting against "record now, decrypt later" attacks.
pqc_roadmap_details: SKT plans to combine PQC SIM with additional quantum expertise to achieve end-to-end quantum-safe communications.
testing_&_validation_methods: Successful real condition trial on 5G standalone network.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Partnership between SK Telecom and Thales.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Tested in trial 5G standalone network environment.

product_brief: A layered, quantum-resilient network solution providing encryption and key management for critical infrastructure.
pqc_capability_description: The solution is described as "quantum-resilient" and "quantum-safe," utilizing a layered architecture that applies encryption and key management solutions across network layers. It addresses risks like "harvest now, decrypt later." Specific PQC algorithms are not named; it mentions symmetric encryption mechanisms.
crypto_primitives: Symmetric encryption mechanisms (specific algorithms not stated)
key_management_model: Key governance managed by a Security Management System (SMS) in a physically secured operations center.
architecture_type: Layered architecture applying encryption and key management across network layers.
primary_platforms: Data Center Interconnection (DCI), campus networks, and hybrid cloud environments.
target_industries: Finance, energy, healthcare, defense, and telecommunications.
pqc_roadmap_details: Described as an ongoing process requiring a multifaceted approach; no specific timeline or algorithm choices stated.

product_brief: IPsec Security Gateway enabling quantum-safe cryptography for mobile transport networks.
pqc_capability_description: Successfully demonstrated quantum-safe IPsec cryptography for mobile subscribers. This is described as the first deployment of its kind to safeguard mobile networks against quantum-era threats. It encrypts data packets at the network layer using Nokia’s IPsec Security Gateway.

product_brief: World’s first distributed cryptography system integrating QKD and PQC for quantum-secure communication.
pqc_capability_description: The system integrates post-quantum cryptography (PQC) with quantum key distribution (QKD) into a unified hybrid architecture. It uses mathematical problems believed to be hard for quantum computers to resist decryption, providing redundancy alongside QKD. It has passed multiple field tests and is in commercial rollout.
crypto_primitives: RSA, elliptic curve cryptography (mentioned as vulnerable legacy methods being replaced/protected against); specific PQC algorithms not named.
key_management_model: Hybrid model merging encryption keys generated by quantum physics (QKD) with encryption methods designed to resist quantum algorithm attacks (PQC).
architecture_type: Distributed cryptography system with a three-tier architecture (likely QKD layer, PQC layer, and application layer).
pqc_roadmap_details: System is currently being rolled out commercially across 16 cities, forming a nationwide backbone.
qkd_protocols_&_quantum_networking: Uses quantum key distribution (QKD) utilizing photons; specific protocols (e.g., BB84) not stated. Network includes 1,100 km of QKD fiber linking 8 core nodes and 159 access points in Hefei.
